reference_inference: Dimensions and hidden structure are inferred from five perspective photographs.
representation: Separate manufactured closed shells. Gear bays are cut into the body. One base-color image; scalar roughness and metalness. The nozzle and sensor window are open surfaces.

shading.method: Blender 4.5 bundled Smooth by Angle geometry node modifier

authored_texture.description: Reference-based grey fields, metal seams, access panels and restrained wear. Existing markings and island layout are retained.

normal_round_trip.method: Each evaluated source corner normal must match a GLB normal at the same world position.

round_trip.axis_note: Undo standard glTF Y-up import conversion for the documented game Z-up export.

gear_retraction.test: Source vertices, edge midpoints and triangle centres are inside the intact R4 body envelope. Open gear bay space is included.
